Ever since I was a child I have wanted to turn unstructured data into actionable business insights.

Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone measured risk-adjusted returns over student constructed portfolios for
institutional and risk-averse investors.

I care about financial modeling, market analysis, how people interact and organize in business settings, achieving alpha, and jiu jitsu.

**Currently looking for** quantitative financial research or fund management roles
starting August, 2026. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
